title: Claudette Colvin, Who Refused to Give Her Bus Seat to a White...
content: Claudette Colvin, Who Refused to Give Her Bus Seat to a White Woman, Dies at 86. “History had me glued to the seat.” Her refusal predates Rosa Parks’ similar stand, but she was deemed “too dark-skinned and too poor” to be a civil rights symbol.
author: Jason Kottke
